fact: The European Commission's action document for PASS IV under the 2025 annual action plan for Mauritania states that the DHIS2 health information system is now deployed nationally, that data quality remains uneven for want of qualified staff and connectivity, that a digital health strategy 2024-2030 is in place (telemedicine, electronic medical records, integrated management systems), and that the Ministry of Health service in charge of the national health information system compiles and finally processes the data; its logframe gives 0 interoperable digital services in 2024 against a target of 5, the patient record among them.
title: Annexe 2 de la décision d'exécution de la Commission relative au financement du plan d'action annuel en faveur de la République Islamique de Mauritanie pour 2025 : Document d'action « Programme d'appui au secteur de la santé – PASS IV »
